_help: Voice profiles per race. 'edge' lists Microsoft neural voices (free), 'elevenlabs' lists ElevenLabs voice IDs (paid, from your Voice Library). Each NPC always gets the same voice from its list. pitch/rate only apply to edge. Races come from the NPC's 3D model; if unknown, 'zones' guesses from the zone/subzone name. 'monster' = non-humanoid model, 'narrator' = objects, items and the quest log. 'profiles_de' is used with --language de.
